summary: PRF Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 25, 2026, attaching a press release announcing expanded preclinical results for its lead product candidate PRF-110. The results from a head-to-head study compare PRF-110 to ZYNRELEF, showing comparable analgesic efficacy, a favorable pharmacokinetic profile, and enhanced local tissue retention. No financial terms, deal structures, or special-situation actions are disclosed. The filing is a routine update on preclinical research progress, not a special situation.
